name: Series Studio
description: Episodic video series team with recurring, consistent characters: a Showrunner that scripts episodes into shot lists, keeps a character bible (portraits, reference sheets, bound voices), generates identity-consistent shots with shot-to-shot continuity, and assembles captioned episodes, all recorded in the persistent series library. Provider-neutral: the Studio toolkit decides which configured image, video, speech and lipsync tools are used. Install the studio-library, series-library, video-composer and ffmpeg-guide skill templates first (Studio setup does this), then assign a provider/model to the five agents.
